data.description:
## Incident Overview

Discovered during real-data application against PR #140 (epic d076-d35e-55db-4843). Cherry-pick failed on commit b7231a3783 when redistributing to story/d076.../5921-e956-b444-4b49 (S3 — rulesets).

## Root cause

The investigation for bug 85f3-8301-c1b0-479d (PR #145) specified Option C with five phases including a SPLIT phase: "For SPLIT commits, generate per-story sub-patches via git format-patch -1 <sha> filtered with git diff-tree --name-only intersected with each story's scope; emit synthetic commits with DSO-Origin-SHA trailer; cherry-pick uses git apply --3way of the filtered patch on the new story branch."

The implementation (committed in 73a89680f0 and refined in cc97bbc76a + 486f856a41) classifies commits as SPLIT correctly, but the PUBLISH phase performs a regular `git cherry-pick "$_s"` on the whole commit. There is no patch filtering, no synthetic commit generation, and no per-story sub-patch creation.

Concrete failure case from PR #140 redistribute:
- Commit 6def60b4c2 (trailer S3) creates plugins/dso/scripts/resolve-session-branch.sh (an S5 deliverable) AND plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/check-ruleset-preflight.sh (S3 deliverable). Cross-pollinated.
- Commit b7231a3783 (trailer S3) modifies tests/scripts/test-check-ruleset-preflight.sh — a test file CREATED by commit 964e7a6279 (trailer S5).
- When redistributing S3's group onto a clean main, b7231a3783 fails to apply because the test file doesn't exist (S5's commit creating it was not included in S3's group).

## Suggested fix

Implement the Option C SPLIT path as originally specified:

1. For each SPLIT commit, generate a per-story patch:
   git format-patch -1 --stdout <sha> | filter-patch-by-paths.py <story-scope-tokens> > /tmp/sha-story.patch

2. Apply the filtered patch on the story branch with `git apply --3way` to handle minor context differences.

3. If the filtered patch is empty (no files from this story in the commit), skip — the commit has nothing for this story.

4. Synthesize a new commit on the story branch with the original subject + a DSO-Origin-SHA trailer recording the source SHA.

5. Each story branch then contains ONLY its declared files; cross-story dependencies are avoided because each story owns its scope.

A helper script (filter-patch-by-paths.py or filter-patch-by-paths.sh) is needed for the patch-filtering step.

## Workaround for PR #140 specifically

Until this is fixed, PR #140 cannot be fully redistributed. Options:
- Take the partial success (PR #151 for S1) as validation of the architecture for clean-cut stories.
- For SPLIT-heavy stories, defer to integration review (un-provenanced commits route into ci.yml's narrow scope).
- Manually patch-filter and cherry-pick per story (expensive, not autonomous).

- Companion to cd29-0242-9df3-4118 (safety fix, P1, closed)
- Companion to 85f3-8301-c1b0-479d (recovery mechanism, closed but incomplete)
